critical.issue: FIXED: `_require_admin` lançait PermissionError au lieu de HTTPException(403), causant une réponse 500 Internal Server Error pour les utilisateurs non-admin (au lieu de 403 Forbidden). Corrigé en remplaçant `raise PermissionError("Admin only")` par `raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Admin only")`.

Le contenu de l'onglet (ProductsTab) se rafraîchit correctement, mais pas le badge de la tab bar.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: admin_product_routes.py - _require_admin raised PermissionError instead of HTTPException
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: FastAPI does not handle Python's built-in PermissionError - it propagates as an unhandled exception causing a 500 Internal Server Error. HTTPException is the correct FastAPI mechanism for returning HTTP error responses.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: Call GET /api/admin/products/pending with non-admin user token → 500 Internal Server Error
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Changed `raise PermissionError('Admin only')` to `raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail='Admin only')`. Also added `from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, HTTPException` import.
